TraitDef.label: Hucow
TraitDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a hucow - docile, bred for milk, and content to be milked like livestock. Willing to be milked without restraints and produces more milk. Cannot do most work, and must be milked daily or {PAWN_possessive} udders grow sore.
